= Configuration reference
// Generated from the config structs by `UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo test -p config`. Do not edit.

The server reads an optional TOML file (`--config <path>`, example: `config/app.example.toml`)
and then environment variables. Every key can be set as `APP__<SECTION>__<KEY>`
(nested tables add further `__` parts). Secrets (API keys, the Meilisearch master key,
OIDC client secret, S3 secret key) should only be set through the environment;
they are never written back or logged.

== `[auth]`

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`secure_cookies` |`APP__AUTH__SECURE_COOKIES` |boolean |`true` |Send cookies with `Secure` (disable only for plain-HTTP development).
|`session_days` |`APP__AUTH__SESSION_DAYS` |integer |`30` |Session lifetime in days (sliding).
|`sign_in_mode` |`APP__AUTH__SIGN_IN_MODE` |`page` \| `auto` |`"page"` |`page` (sign-in page) or `auto` (straight to the default identity provider, addendum-1 4.3; needs a tested provider). `cli admin disable-sso-only` sets `page`.
|`signup` |`APP__AUTH__SIGNUP` |`open` \| `invite` \| `closed` |`"invite"` |
|===

== `[auth.oidc]`

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`admin_groups` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__ADMIN_GROUPS` |list of string |- |Members of these groups are admins when `role_source = "provider"`.
|`allowed_groups` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__ALLOWED_GROUPS` |list of string |- |Only members of these groups may sign in (empty: everyone).
|`auto_create` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__AUTO_CREATE` |boolean |- |Create an account on first OIDC sign-in even when sign-up is not open.
|`client_id` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__CLIENT_ID` |string |- |
|`client_secret` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__CLIENT_SECRET` |string |- |Set through `APP__AUTH__OIDC__CLIENT_SECRET`.
|`display_name` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__DISPLAY_NAME` |string |- |Button label on the sign-in page.
|`groups_claim` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__GROUPS_CLAIM` |string |- |Claim that lists the groups (ID token, else `UserInfo`).
|`issuer` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__ISSUER` |string |- |Issuer URL used for discovery (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`).
|`role_source` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__ROLE_SOURCE` |`local` \| `provider` |- |`local` (roles are set in the admin area) or `provider` (recomputed from `admin_groups` at every sign-in; needs `admin_groups`, OD-16).
|`scopes` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__SCOPES` |list of string |- |Scopes to request; `openid` is always added. Empty: `openid profile email`.
|`slug` |`APP__AUTH__OIDC__SLUG` |string |- |Short name in URLs (`/api/v1/auth/oidc/start?provider=<slug>`).
|===

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]

== `[jobs]`

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`catalog_max_age_days` |`APP__JOBS__CATALOG_MAX_AGE_DAYS` |integer |`150` |Days after which catalog data from a source whose terms limit caching (TMDB: six months) is refreshed by the daily retention job, or purged when no refresh is possible (no key, source switched off). 1 to 170; such data is purged at 175 days in any case.
|`concurrency` |`APP__JOBS__CONCURRENCY` |integer |`4` |Concurrent jobs per worker process.
|`shutdown_grace_secs` |`APP__JOBS__SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECS` |integer |`20` |Seconds a stopping worker waits for running jobs.
|===

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]

== `[secrets]`

Encryption of secrets at rest (addendum-1 section 2).

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`ephemeral` |`APP__SECRETS__EPHEMERAL` |boolean |`false` |Use a temporary in-memory key when neither the key file nor `keys` exists. For test harnesses only: values encrypted under it cannot be read after a restart, so start-up still refuses when the database already holds encrypted values, and plain-text values from earlier versions are left unencrypted. Never implied by the storage backend.
|`key_file` |`APP__SECRETS__KEY_FILE` |string |`"data/secrets.key"` |Key file, one key per line (`v<n>:<base64 of 32 bytes>`, newest first). Generated with mode 0600 on the first start when neither the file nor `keys` exists. Back it up together with the database.
|`keys` |`APP__SECRETS__KEYS` |string |- |The same lines joined with `,`, for operators who prefer the environment (`APP__SECRETS__KEYS`). The key file wins when both exist.
|===

== `[server]`

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`assets_base_url` |`APP__SERVER__ASSETS_BASE_URL` |string |- |Optional CDN base URL for `/assets/...` (D-7).
|`bind` |`APP__SERVER__BIND` |string |`"127.0.0.1:3000"` |Address the HTTP server listens on.
|`csp_report_only` |`APP__SERVER__CSP_REPORT_ONLY` |boolean |`false` |Send the content security policy as `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`: the browser reports what the policy would refuse in its console and refuses nothing. For finding out whether the policy is the reason something does not load.
|`hsts_max_age_secs` |`APP__SERVER__HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECS` |integer |`31536000` |Seconds a browser remembers to use HTTPS only for this host (`Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=...`). The header is sent only when `public_url` starts with `https://`; `0` never sends it (for a proxy that sets its own, or while an address is still being tried out: a browser that saw the header refuses plain HTTP for that host until the time is over).
|`public_url` |`APP__SERVER__PUBLIC_URL` |string |`"http://localhost:3000"` |Public base URL (links in emails, OIDC redirect, share links).
|`role` |`APP__SERVER__ROLE` |`all` \| `web` \| `worker` |`"all"` |Default role; the `--role` flag overrides it.
|`trusted_proxies` |`APP__SERVER__TRUSTED_PROXIES` |list of string |`[]` |Reverse proxies (addresses or CIDR networks, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`) whose `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Request-Id` are believed for audit rows (DEC-284). Empty: the socket address.
|===

== `[storage]`

The `storage` section of the configuration (D-8).

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`backend` |`APP__STORAGE__BACKEND` |`fs` \| `s3` \| `memory` |`"fs"` |
|`fetch_policy` |`APP__STORAGE__FETCH_POLICY` |`lazy` \| `library` \| `eager` |`"library"` |Which images get bytes ahead of being requested (D-8).
|`formats` |`APP__STORAGE__FORMATS` |list of `avif` \| `webp` |`["avif", "webp"]` |
|`fs_legacy_root` |`APP__STORAGE__FS_LEGACY_ROOT` |string |- |fs only: the blob root of an earlier layout. At start the server moves its directories `up`, `img`, `http` and `orig` into `fs_root` unless `fs_root` has them already (the container image sets `/data`: its blobs used to lie around the secrets key). The admin CLI never moves them: its storage commands refuse to run until the server has.
|`fs_root` |`APP__STORAGE__FS_ROOT` |string |`"data/blobs"` |Root directory of the fs backend.
|`high_watermark` |`APP__STORAGE__HIGH_WATERMARK` |number |`0.9` |Start evicting above this fraction of the cap.
|`http_cache_max_bytes` |`APP__STORAGE__HTTP_CACHE_MAX_BYTES` |string |`"2GiB"` |Limit for raw provider responses kept by the HTTP cache.
|`keep_originals` |`APP__STORAGE__KEEP_ORIGINALS` |boolean |`false` |
|`low_watermark` |`APP__STORAGE__LOW_WATERMARK` |number |`0.75` |Evict down to this fraction of the cap.
|`max_source_pixels` |`APP__STORAGE__MAX_SOURCE_PIXELS` |string |`"4096x4096"` |
|`max_total_bytes` |`APP__STORAGE__MAX_TOTAL_BYTES` |string |`"20GiB"` |Hard cap for all stored bytes (pinned and cache tier).
|`min_free_disk` |`APP__STORAGE__MIN_FREE_DISK` |string |`"5GiB"` |fs only: never let free space on the volume drop below this.
|`per_user_upload_quota` |`APP__STORAGE__PER_USER_UPLOAD_QUOTA` |string |`"1GiB"` |Per-user limit for uploads (play photos, avatars).
|`variants` |`APP__STORAGE__VARIANTS` |list of `thumb` \| `card` \| `detail` \| `full` |`["thumb", "card", "detail"]` |Which variants to materialise.
|===

== `[usage]`

First-party usage measurement (WP4-5, design.md 9, research R-54).

[cols="2,3,2,2,4"]
|===
|Key |Environment |Type |Default |Description

|`funnel` |`APP__USAGE__FUNNEL` |boolean |`true` |Count the logging funnel: how many taps and how long logging takes, and which settings sections people open, as daily totals without any user or item, kept 180 days.
